<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Reflexive Grapple](/Feats.aspx?ID=5483) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 75

**Archetype** [Thlipit Contestant](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=224)

**Prerequisites**
[Thlipit Contestant Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5474)

</column>

---

You've honed your reflexes so well that your lash can begin closing around a target as soon as it makes contact. Make a lash Strike; if the Strike hits, you can immediately attempt to [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=2376) the target. Both actions count toward your multiple attack penalty, but don't increase your penalty until you've made both attacks.
name: Reflexive Grapple
